name: dlfs_delete
description: Delete a file or empty directory from a DLFS drive. Directories must be empty before deletion. The operation is irreversible at the API level (though the underlying lattice retains history via tombstones).

drive.description: Drive name, or a DID-URL reference to another user's drive (e.g. 'did:key:zOwner.../drive')

path.description: Path of the file or empty directory to delete

ucans.description: Optional UCAN JWT proofs authorising delegated access to another user's drive
